Mama ta ce, "ikon Allah, kuma wai da gaske tana cikin farin cikin?." Abiy ya kalle yayi shiru kafin ya ce, "bakya so ta kasance da farin cikin ne?." Mama ta ɗan buɗe ido kaɗan ta ce, "A'a ba haka nake nufi ba, kawai dai naga a yadda auren ya zo ne, shi mijin nata ba so yake ba shiyasa na tambaya."

"To ina yi miki albishir da yanzu ya fita son zaman aurensu, ƙaunar da Nayla take yi masa ba komai ba ce akan wacce yake yi mata, wata ƙauna yake nuna mata mai matuƙar zafi da zallar kulawa. A gaban idanuna ba ya jin nauyin nuna mata soyayya da kulawa, tunda har ya bayyana ƙaunar da yake mata a gabana kowa zai tabbatar soyayyar da yake yi mata babu ƙarya a cikinta."

Bazan bari Nayla ta yi farin ciki ba, yadda babarta bata bar ni farin ciki ba itama baza ta yi ba wallahi. Wai ya fara sonta, zai daina son na ta kuwa wallahi" ta faɗa tana ɗaukar waya hannu na rawa ta kira number Aziza, dan a san abinda za a yi kafin lokaci ya ƙure.

Nayla tunda Omar ya fita ya barta da tunani, ko ya ta motsa sai ta ji kamar a kan cinyarsa take ko kuma taji ɗumin bakinsa akan goshinta. Tana zaune ita kaɗai tana ta murmushi kamar wacce ta samu matsala, in ta tuna yanayin bata sanin ta yi murmushi, farin ciki kuwa kamar ita kaɗai ce a duniya haka take ji. Mai aikin ta ce ta gama yi mata komai har turaren wuta aka yi a falo, ta bata kuɗi a siyo mata abinda zata yi amfani dashi ta yi mata komai sannan ta tafi. 

Nayla tunanin abinda zata girka take yi, cikin iyayi aka shiga kitchen aka ɗora mandi rice bayan ta gama gasa tilapia fish, ta yi masa haɗi mai kyau yana ta ƙhamshi ko ƙarninsa ba ka ji. Gidan ta shiga da sallama ya amsa yana fitowa daga falon ya ce, "har kin gama?." Nayla ta ce, "eh." Ta faɗa tana kallon tsakar gidan abinda ya faru a kwanakin baya yana dawowa zuciyarta. Bangon da ya rits ta da wuƙa ta kalla tayi murmushi ta ce, "A nan wajan ka ɗora min wuƙa a wuyana, na ga tashin hankali a ranar." 

Abinda bata taɓa gani yayi ba yayi, dariya taga yana yi sosai har ta waiwayo tana kallonsa duk da gidan babu haske. Suna haɗa ido ya tsayar da dariyar bai ce komai ba sai da ya ƙaraso inda take ya ce, "mu je." Mamakin abinda ya bashi dariya haka take yia haka suka fito suka nufi komawa gida kamar ɗazu.

Shi ya buɗe gidan ta shiga ya biyo bayanta kamar jira ake ta shiga aka kira wayarta. Bata ɗauka ba ta wuce ɗaki ta canja kaya zuwa na bacci ta fito falon aka sake kiran wayar a karo na uku kenan. 

Ɗauka ta yi kawai sai ta saka a speaker ta yi sallama ta ji muryar namiji ya amsa. Bata kowa komai a ranta ba ta ce, "Waye yake magana?." Daga wayar aka ce, "Hawwa Najib ne, your colleague." Gaban Nayla ya faɗi ganin Omar a tsaye a kanta, sai ta ɗan ruɗe kaɗan, amma gudun kar ya kawo wani abun a zuciyarsa sai ta ce, "Najib ya aiki?" Ta faɗa tana kallon Omar da yake tsaye har lokacin.

Daga wayar ya ce, "fine. I hope kwana biyu kina lafiya, baki zuwa aiki na tambaya an ce kin ɗauki hutu, i hope everything is going well?." Nayla kasa bashi amsa tayi saboda kallon da Omar yake mata, gashi ya dawo kan kujera ya zauna zuba mata ido yana kallo. Sai ta yanke wayar da sauri ta kashe ta gabaɗaya, ya zuba mata ido na wani lokaci yana jin zuciyarsa kamar zata fio waje saboda kishi.

Shiru ya ratsa falon na wani lokaci kanta yana ƙasa ƙirjinta yana bugawa sosai, kallon da yake mata kaɗai ta san ta yi laifi ko bai faɗa ba. Kanta yana sunkuye ta ji ya ce," daga ranar da abokin aiki ya sauke ki a mota na fara jin zafi a zuciyata, ban ɗauki abin da mahimamci sosai ba amma na kasa ɓoyewa har sai da na yi miki magana. A lokacin da naji Didi tana yi miki maganar samarinki shima na kasa ɓoyewa sai da nayi magana, wani ya biyo ki ya ce yana sonki na kasa ɓoyewa shima na yi magana. Da na fahimci da jikinki ake yin talla na ji tashin hankali da ɓacin ran da ban taɓa jin irin shi ba a duniya, wani abu mai kama da yaji naji yana mamaye idanuna da zuciyata. Duk a lokcin ban san kishi nake ba, ban san haka ake jin kishi ba shiyasa ban fahimta ba sai da aka faɗa min. Yanzu da na sani na tabbatar da zafinsa, na tabbatar da raɗaɗi da ƙunar da kishi yake dashi. Ban ga laifin masu illata mutane akan kishi ba, ban ga laifin masu raunata kansu akan kishi ba, ban ga laifin ba su kashe kan su akan kishi ba, domin abinda na ji a zuciyata in aka ce zan iya zama sanadin taɓuwar lafiyar wani bazan yi musu ba."

Shiru ta ji ya yi kafin ta ji ya ce, "Jidda!." Gabanta ya faɗi sosai, ta ɗago a hankali ta ce, "Na'am."

Ƙarasawa banɗakin ya yi ya buɗe, wata irin zabura tayi ta haɗe jikinta waje ɗaya tana kallonsa alamun tsoronsa take yi. Ƙare mata kallo yake yi da alama tunda ta shiga baɗakin babu abinda ta yi. Fuskarta ya kalla suka haɗa ido, ta haɗɗiye wayu jikinta yana cigaba rawa.

Bai nuna mata ba ya ce, "ki tashi ki kwanta" ya faɗa ba tare da ya amsa ba. Jikin ta yana rawa ta miƙe ko hijjab ɗin bata cire ba ta kwanta, sabon tsoronsa take ji yana ratsa ilahirin jikinta. Numfashi ya ji tana ja alamun mai kuka, ya juya ya kalle ta ya ce, "ki daina kuka, ki yi bacci." Kamar wacce ya bawa umarni ta rufe ido ruf tare da toshe bakinta da hannunta. Yana zaune a wajan har baccin tsoro ya ɗauke ta sannan ya tashi ya fita daga ɗakin.

Waya ta ɗauka tana kallon agogo ta ga ƙarfe uku a lokacin kuma ruwan ya tsaya, hannun ta yana rawa ta shiga lambarsa ta kira shi bai ɗauka ba, sai ta rubuta masa text na zata je gidan Didi.

Shi kansa sai ya ji tafiyar ta fita daga ransa, dan baya so ya yi nisa da ita kamar yadda bata so.

Sati uku kawai zan yi, kuma kinga biki za ku yi zaki ga lokacin ya yi saurin dawowa tunda kina cikin ƴan uwanki."
